description: A Living Library You Can Talk To. Open-source educational platform with 30 historical figures from philosophy, science, art, mysticism, and activism. Stories, dialogues, AI conversation, multi-figure councils. Nonprofit, BYOK, self-hostable, no behavioral tracking.
